messages.subject: forced_choice for demographic questions
parts:
Hi,

Using your wiki example, I've successfully created an adaptive assessment to host on shinyapps.io, and everything is working nearly perfectly. I have forced_choice set to TRUE in my shinyGUI_list object. However, this only works for the items from the item bank. Is there an easy way to make responses to the demographic questions mandatory?

Thanks,
-Zac
